_comment: Tier-2: DEM wall geometry uses RigidFace3D3N / RigidFace3D4N. Pitfall (kratos.dem #2: 'Wall geometry: use RigidFace3D3N elements or the walls_process_list'). The catalog Signal for this entry is the shared 'RuntimeError KeyError from JSON parsing' boilerplate, which is NOT what happens — the real signal is a registry rejection. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv). RigidFace3D3N and RigidFace3D4N construct as CONDITIONS (not elements, as the pitfall's wording implies); RigidFace2D2N and RigidEdge3D2N raise 'is not registered', consistent with Kratos DEM being 3D-internal. FALSE-SIGNAL and element-vs-condition wording noted in the report. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX SHIFTED by the guidance reclassification; the claim this fixture verifies is unchanged and every #index quoted above is the current one. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS the expected registration status of all 4 entities -- it claims the opposite of what this build registers, while still really calling CreateNewElement/CreateNewCondition for each name. Every registered[...] line then disagrees with itself and registry_mismatches goes from 0 to 4. This proves the booleans come from a real registry lookup on this build and that a wrong claim is caught. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 4 registered[<name>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, registry_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dem_wall_rigidface_is_3d_only && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
_key_correction: Was keyed dem::2. dem::2 is '[Input] The wall file is silently optional', a claim about a MISSING mdpa file, which this fixture never creates or omits. What it probes is which wall CONDITION names are registered -- RigidFace3D3N / RigidFace3D4N construct while RigidFace2D2N and RigidEdge3D2N raise 'is not registered!'. That is dem::14, '[API] Wall geometry is built from CONDITIONS'. Re-keyed 2026-08-07; the fixture's code and expectations are unchanged.
